input:
Earlier scenes:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。他们在很漂亮的河找夹竹桃。神农问他的哥哥：“我应该吃这种植物吗？”哥哥说：“这就要看你想要安全还是接近知道了。“神农一吃夹竹桃就生病了。哥哥说：“太麻烦了。

This scene:
夹竹桃是毒的，我想知道灵芝会帮他。”哥哥给神农灵芝。神农吃完了以后开始痊愈了。神农说：“谢谢哥哥，你帮得真好。灵芝我们可以吃，特别是如果我们已经吃了夹竹桃。“

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 夹竹桃是毒的：有毒的
- 我想知道灵芝会帮他：灵芝有没有用/能不能帮他
- 哥哥给神农灵芝：给了，了completed
- 你帮得真好：你做得很好

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 夹竹桃是毒的：夹竹桃有毒，毒 is a noun; use 有毒 to describe the property that a plant contains poison.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 开始痊愈了：开始好起来了，痊愈 means fully recovering, so it does not fit naturally after 开始; 好起来 describes the beginning of recovery.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农吃完了以后开始痊愈了：他吃完了以后开始好起来了，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the same character was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other character competes as the referent.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农说：他说，use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character.
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 哥哥给神农灵芝：哥哥给了神农灵芝，use 了 after 给 to mark the completed action of giving the medicine.

items.reason: 毒 is not used directly as an adjective here; 有毒 correctly describes the plant.
痊愈 normally denotes full recovery, so 开始痊愈 is an unsuitable collocation; 开始好起来了 is natural.
Because the preceding sentence mentions both 哥哥 and 神农, replacing 神农 with 他 makes the referent unclear.
神农 was the immediately preceding subject, so 他说 is the required close re-reference.
The completed act of giving the lingzhi needs 了 after 给.
